title: Paid, disputed and promised products in one call
script: Verified with 3 June 1987 and 2288. Cannot pay today. The credit card was paid this morning. She never had a personal loan. She pays the car loan in full this Friday. Confirms once.
lines: No, not today. The credit card I already paid this morning. And I never had a personal loan with you, that one is not mine.
The car loan I can pay in full this Friday.
checks: the call continues after the paid claim and the dispute (rule B9)
no argument about the disputed loan
one note per product without a promise (rule B8)

title: Restructuring after an agreed but unrecorded promise
script: Gives 19 October 1983 and 4410 correctly. Cannot pay today. Agrees to pay the credit card in full tomorrow. For the two loans he asks for lower instalments and a new payment plan.
lines: No, not today. I can pay the credit card in full tomorrow.
For the two loans I need lower instalments. Can we set up a new payment plan?
checks: the agreed credit card promise is not recorded (rule B10)
no add_note before or after the transfer

title: One product paid, hardship on the other, support declined
script: Verified with 8 January 1991 and 6604. The credit card was paid yesterday. She lost her job last month and cannot pay the loan. Declines the support team.
lines: No. The credit card I already paid yesterday. For the loan, I lost my job last month and I cannot pay anything right now.
No, thank you, I do not want to be transferred.
checks: one short sympathy sentence and no persuasion attempt on the loan
the support team is offered once
the close reason is the first product, in get_account order, whose note is not paid
